question.text: In the reaction $2 \mathrm{PCl}_{5} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{PCl}_{4}^{+}+\mathrm{PCl}_{6}^{-}$, the change in hybridisation is from

options.text: $s p^{3} d$ to $s p^{2}$ and $s p^{3}$

solution.text:
$2 \mathrm{PCl}_{5} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{PCl}_{4}^{+}+\mathrm{PCl}_{6}^{-}$

$\uparrow s p^{3} d \quad \uparrow s p^{3} \quad \uparrow s p^{3} d^{2}$
